title: Error
description: The error envelope, identical to the HTTP one. See docs/architecture/shared/04-errors-and-http.md.

code.description: Stable, for client logic. Changing one is a breaking change.

messageKey.description: For display. The client translates it — the server never sends prose.

params.description: Interpolation values for the message key.

traceId.description: Lets a user report the problem and someone find it in the log.

details.description: Validation only: every invalid field, not just the first.
